main_claim: Wall thickness changes coupled physical pressure at fixed outer geometry and load, so curvature and pad stiffness alone cannot define the useful rigid-gap regime.
purpose: Repository supplement for automatic physical support/pressure validation.

recommended_chart: Two by three pressure maps with shared physical axes and a shared color scale within each pad-stiffness row.
alternatives: A single radial curve would conceal geometric and sampling asymmetry.
uncertainty: Deterministic coarse linear-elastic discrete models; no statistical confidence interval or continuum bound.
exports: 183x142mm editable SVG draft and150dpi preview, then PDF and600dpi PNG after source review.
interpretation: Compare the pressure concentrations across thickness while keeping support extent and actual pressure scales visible. Use the paired model-error table to quantify the rigid/diagonal approximations.
unresolved: Moving nonconvex search, friction history and native geometry/operator preparation remain outside these static controls.
